title: GTA6 Interactive Map Update: 2,700+ Markers & Official Map Plans
description: With GTA6 launching in two weeks, a community developer shares a massive interactive map update featuring over 2,700 markers across Leonida and Vice City, plus upcoming official map integration plans.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Interactive Map Receives Major Update Ahead of Launch

As the community counts down the final weeks before the launch of *Grand Theft Auto VI*, developers within the fan base are busy preparing tools to help players conquer the massive open world. Reddit user u/kalterapfel123 has shared a substantial update on the community-driven interactive map project for GTA6, offering a comprehensive look at what has been built and what is planned for the game's release.

The project has expanded significantly over the past few months, focusing on usability and utility for players once they step foot into Leonida and Vice City.

### Current Features Available Now

- **Over 2,700 Markers**: The map features more than 2,700 precisely positioned markers across the game's setting.
- **Advanced Search & Filtering**: Includes searchable locations, detailed categories, active filters, and marker previews.
- **Mobile & Navigation Overhaul**: The interface and map navigation have been specifically improved for mobile devices.
- **User Accounts & Personalization**: Players can create free user accounts to save favorite locations, track visited spots, and customize personal map settings.
- **Shareable Links**: Users can generate direct share links for individual markers.

### What's Next: Official Map Integration & Layer System

Looking ahead, the development team is preparing a new map layer system. The long-term plan is to integrate the official Leonida map data after *GTA6* releases.

Importantly, the impressive community-made reconstruction crafted by Yanis and the GTA VI Mapping community will be kept available as an optional layer. The team is also working on transparency controls, allowing users to eventually overlay the community reconstruction and the official maps to compare them directly. Additionally, a GTA V comparison layer is currently being tested, though final integration will depend on the official map data.

### Community Feedback Appreciated

As the account system and various features are still being refined, the creator is actively seeking feedback from the community regarding bugs, confusing menus, or general usability—particularly on mobile devices and regarding what features players will find most useful post-launch.

Credits for the current map artwork go to Yanis V17 and the GTA VI Mapping community for their hard work in reconstructing Leonida from available material, which serves as the foundation for these interactive tools and databases.

## Editor's Take

(Analysis) Community-made interactive maps are an essential companion for the launch of massive open-world titles like GTA6. This project stands out due to its ambition, especially the planned transparency comparison layers between community reconstructions and the upcoming official map. It's a promising tool worth keeping an eye on as we approach release day.
